description: Updates the `text` field of a specific Trello comment action, identified by `idAction`.

idAction.description: The unique identifier of the action (comment) to be updated.
idAction.title: Id Action

text.description: The new text content for the action (comment). Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters.
examples: This is the updated comment text regarding the project status.
text.title: Text
